SCUQ1.label: Unclear / No Query

SCUQ1.1.label: Empty Chat / No Content
SCUQ1.1.description: Definition: The chat contains no customer message or stated issue. Also: a chat transcript email that contains only agent text (for example the agent sending the transcript of our chat, or saying the chat disconnected) and no customer message stating an issue. Agent boilerplate, greetings and sign-offs do not count as a customer message.

SCUQ1.2.label: Auto-reply / Bounce Email
SCUQ1.2.description: Definition: The ticket is an automatic reply or delivery-failure message, not a real query.

SCUQ1.3.label: Feedback / Survey Form
SCUQ1.3.description: Definition: The ticket is a feedback or survey submission.

SCUQ1.4.label: Resolved / Thank-you Only
SCUQ1.4.description: Definition: The customer only confirms resolution or says thanks. Use only when the CUSTOMER writes to confirm resolution or to say thanks. An agent thanking the customer or closing the chat is not this value.

SCUQ1.5.label: Spam / Irrelevant
SCUQ1.5.description: Definition: The message is spam or unrelated to Scopus.

SCUQ1.6.label: Awaiting Customer Information
SCUQ1.6.description: Definition: Support asked for details or screenshots and the customer did not supply them, so the issue stayed undefined.

SCUQ1.7.label: Unknown / Not Stated
SCUQ1.7.description: Definition: No discernible issue is present in the conversation.

SCUQ1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified at Level 1 as 'Unclear / No Query'. Choose the Level 2 value from this group only. 'Unclear / No Query' means: Definition: Empty chats, bounce/auto-reply emails, survey/feedback forms, spam, thank-you or 'resolved' only, with no discernible issue even after reading the agent text and subject.
